ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the ecosystem shown in the diagram, which animal would have a decreased food source if ferns were removed from the web?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is an ecological food web diagram, containing multiple animals and plants and arrow relationships. In the lower-left corner there is a picture of a fern plant labeled “Fern”; near its upper right there is an animal labeled “Mountain beaver.” It can be seen that there is an arrow from “Fern” pointing to “Mountain beaver.” Reasoning: The question asks if ferns are removed from the food web, which animal’s food source would decrease. Arrows in a food web indicate that food or energy flows from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Therefore, ferns are one of the food sources of the mountain beaver; if ferns are removed, the mountain beaver’s food source would decrease.
